sentences.text: Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 37928 of 2022

Applicant :- Pawan
Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Applicant :- Mohd. Khalil
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Saurabh Shyam Shamshery,J.
1.

Applicant-Pawan has approached this Court by way of filing present bail application seeking
enlargement on bail in Case Crime No. 71 of 2018, under Sections 498A, 304B, 201 Ipc and 3/4
Dowry Prohibition Act, Police Station Pilkhuwa, District Hapur.

entities.text: Dowry Prohibition Act, Police Station Pilkhuwa, District Hapur
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: 2.  This application is pending for about one and half years.
Sri Mohd. Khalil, learned counsel for applicant is not present.

3. Sri Rakesh Kumar Mishra, learned AGA appearing for State, submits that applicant is in jail since 28.02.2018 and is facing trial for offence of dowry death, disappearance of evidence and demand of dowry.
According to post mortem report immediate cause of death was asphyxia due to strangulation, however, it does not appear that charge of murder is also framed.
Present status of trial is not on record.

Pawan vs State Of U.P. on 10 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/167127016/
1

4. In aforesaid circumstances, since present status of trial is not on record and taking note of manner of assault, post mortem report and period of detention of applicant, in the interest of justice, even in absence of counsel for applicant, this application is disposed of with liberty to applicant to approach afresh after a reasonable period alongwith status report of trial.
5. A copy of this order be communicated to applicant through Jail Superintendent concerned.

Order Date :- 10.4.2024 AK  Pawan vs State Of U.P. on 10 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/167127016/
